description.en: A curated registry of rare animated React components built with Motion and shadcn.
description.zh: 精选小众且高辨识度的 React 动效组件集：基于 Motion 与 Tailwind 打造，支持 shadcn CLI 一键安装。

content.en: Rare UI is a free, open-source registry of distinctive, animation-driven React components created to help interfaces break away from cookie-cutter designs. Built on Tailwind CSS and Motion, every element—from physics-based gravity letters and interactive 3D fluid orbs to tactile duration pickers and macOS-style expanding folder drawers—is contained within a single file. Users can copy the source directly or install any component into modern React and Next.js applications using the standard shadcn CLI.
content.zh: Rare UI 是一套拒绝平庸同质化设计的开源小众 React 动效组件集。专注于提供常规组件库鲜少涵盖的高交互质感元素：包括带物理碰撞跌落的重力字符（Gravity Letters）、可交互流动光球（Fluid Orb）、仿 macOS 折叠收纳效果的文件夹卡片（Folder Component）、触觉反馈时间选择器（Duration Picker）以及黏性果冻导航（Gooey Nav）。全系基于 Tailwind CSS 与 Motion 打造，单组件单文件封装，原生支持通过标准 shadcn CLI 一键引入项目中。
